data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): bridge-fsck invocation path pinned to CLI-JSON (NOT importlib-from-hyphenated-filename). Hyphenated filename 'ticket-bridge-fsck.py' blocks direct Python import. Use: subprocess invokes 'python3 plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-bridge-fsck.py --json' and parses structured JSON output. dd1.json contract field api_path_used values: 'cli-json' (preferred) | 'regex-fallback'. Add RED test asserting cli-json preferred when --json flag available. Rationale: ambiguous import vs subprocess path would force importlib hacks or silent regex degradation (implicit_assumption).
